messages:
Marisol: Hey team — running through the new quickstart from the repo. First call fails when I'm behind our corp HTTP proxy: curl shows ECONNRESET. When I bypass the proxy I get a 403 JSON body that says something about billing. Anyone seen this proxy + billing behavior?

Ben: can you paste the exact curl and which SDK/runtime you tried? Node or Python? @devex-bot might have diagnostics to suggest.

Marisol: here's what I ran (from mac):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxxxxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' \
  --proxy http://corp-proxy.local:3128
```
Response when using proxy: `* Received HTTP/0.9 when not allowed` then `curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer`.

When I removed `--proxy` I get a 403 with body: `{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace requires billing enabled"}}`. SDK (node) surfaces as generic 403 error with no helpful guidance.

Carmen: two separate things here: (1) corp proxies sometimes break CONNECT/TLS or strip Authorization headers, causing ECONNRESET or auth failures. Try `NO_PROXY=api.redwood.dev` or `--proxy-header 'Authorization: Bearer ...'` for curl to force header through. (2) the 403 JSON is the billing gate — new orgs without a payment method get `billing_required`. The console link is https://console.redwood.ai/settings/billing — you need to add a card or enable trial credits.

Ben: adding: our API can return 401/403 inconsistently depending on whether credentials are present vs org state. We do include a `type` field in the JSON so the SDK could map `billing_required` -> actionable error. For proxy: if the proxy performs TLS interception you may need to add corp CA to Node with `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/etc/corp/mitm.pem` or set `SSL_CERT_DIR`. For curl you can test with `--insecure` just to validate it's a cert issue (do not use in prod).

Marisol: good to know. The quickstart README didn't mention NO_PROXY or billing step — I missed adding a card because the onboarding flow wasn't explicit in the sample app. For node SDK I just saw `Error: request failed with status 403` and a thrown stack — no pointer to billing docs. That's a pretty common first-time friction.

Carmen: logged a small DX issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/1327 suggesting: (a) detect `billing_required` and throw BillingRequiredError with a console link, (b) expand quickstart README to mention proxies (NO_PROXY, corp CAs), and (c) improve quickstart script to attempt a pre-flight `GET /v1/org` and surface an actionable message.

devex-bot: Created ticket DX-2024 "Improve quickstart diagnostics for proxy + billing failures" and linked issue #1327.

Ben: short-term workaround for others: 1) run `export NO_PROXY=api.redwood.dev` (or add your workspace domain), 2) check console for billing, 3) add card or request trial via the console UI. We'll aim to get clearer error mapping in the next patch.

Marisol: workaround worked — set NO_PROXY and added payment method; first call now returns 200 and the chat response. Leaving notes for the quickstart PR: please add a small checklist (proxy, CA, billing).

Carmen: @Marisol could you drop the exact node stack trace so we can add a test and example mapping?

Marisol: pasting minimal node trace for reference:
```
Error: Request failed with status code 403
    at createError (/app/node_modules/axios/lib/core/createError.js:16:15)
    at settle (/app/node_modules/axios/lib/core/settle.js:17:12)
    at IncomingMessage.handleStreamEnd (/app/node_modules/axios/lib/adapters/http.js:260:11)
    at IncomingMessage.emit (events.js:400:28)
    at endReadableNT (internal/streams/readable.js:1336:12)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:80:21)
```

devex-bot: Attached stack trace to DX-2024.

billing-bot: Organization 'marisol-team' updated: payment method added, trial credits applied. First call validated.

Carmen: thanks everyone. Action items: Carmen to update quickstart README (PR incoming), Ben to add SDK error mapping for `billing_required`, and devex team to add a small proxy troubleshooting blurb. @Marisol really appreciate the repro steps. :thumbsup:
